title.en: Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo: exchange copy and seal
title.zh: 瓜达卢佩—伊达尔戈条约：交换本与印玺

caption.en: The red-bound exchange copy, given to the United States by Mexico, documents Mexican ratification of the treaty ending the Mexican–American War.
caption.zh: 墨西哥交给美国的红色装帧交换本，记录墨西哥批准结束美墨战争的条约。

alt.en: A red volume with gold decoration and a large suspended seal rests in a blue-lined case.
alt.zh: 金饰红色册本与大型悬挂印玺置于蓝色衬里盒中。

interpretation.en: The red binding and suspended seal belong to Mexico’s ratified exchange copy. The treaty was signed on 2 February; the governments exchanged ratifications at Querétaro on 30 May 1848.
interpretation.zh: 红色装帧与悬挂印玺属于墨西哥批准后的条约交换本。条约于2月2日签署，两国政府于1848年5月30日在克雷塔罗互换批准书。

items.creator: Governments of Mexico and the United States; reproduction by the National Archives

note.en: The underlying treaty is an 1848 official diplomatic instrument in Record Group 11, not a privately donated copyrighted photograph. The NARA milestone page identifies this exchange copy and supplies its institutional reproduction; NARA states its own works are public domain.
note.zh: 1848年官方外交文书，藏于美国政府总档案第11档案组。国家档案馆条目明确标识这份交换本并提供馆方复制图；其自行制作的复制作品属公有领域。

creator.en: Governments of Mexico and the United States; reproduction by the National Archives
creator.zh: 墨西哥与美国政府；国家档案馆复制

date.zh: 1848年交换本；条约于1848年2月2日签署

caption.en: The opening page authorizes military areas from which people could be excluded. Its implementation targeted Japanese Americans on the West Coast.
caption.zh: 首页授权划定可将人员排除在外的军事区域；实施时针对西海岸日裔美国人。

alt.en: A typed executive-order page headed “Authorizing the Secretary of War to Prescribe Military Areas.”
alt.zh: 打字行政命令页，标题为授权战争部长划定军事区域。

interpretation.en: The order gave military commanders broad authority to exclude people from designated areas. Although it did not name Japanese Americans, it enabled their forced removal and incarceration on the West Coast.
interpretation.zh: 命令赋予军事指挥官广泛权力，可将人员排除于指定区域之外。条文未点名日裔美国人，却为西海岸日裔居民的强制迁离和拘禁提供了授权。

creator.en: Franklin D. Roosevelt, President of the United States
creator.zh: 富兰克林·D·罗斯福，美国总统

caption.en: The first page names the military parties and describes a cessation of hostilities pending a final peaceful settlement.
caption.zh: 首页列出军事缔约各方，并说明在最终和平解决前停止敌对行动。

alt.en: A printed page titled Agreement with a preamble concerning a military armistice in Korea.
alt.zh: 印刷协定页，含有关朝鲜军事停战的序言。

interpretation.en: The preamble defines a military cessation of hostilities while a final peaceful settlement remains pending. The agreement is an armistice, not a peace treaty.
interpretation.zh: 序言规定停止军事敌对行动，同时有待达成最终和平解决。该协定属于停战协定，并非和平条约。

title.en: San Cristóbal missile site: reconnaissance briefing photograph
title.zh: 圣克里斯托瓦尔导弹基地：侦察简报照片

caption.en: A U.S. reconnaissance image labels missile trailers, launcher equipment and tent areas at San Cristóbal, Cuba, during the missile crisis.
caption.zh: 美国侦察图像标注导弹危机期间古巴圣克里斯托瓦尔的导弹拖车、发射设备与帐篷区域。

alt.en: An annotated aerial photograph shows roads, clearings and equipment with arrows and a dated title panel.
alt.zh: 带注释的航拍照片显示道路、空地和设备，并有箭头及注明日期的标题框。

interpretation.en: Arrows and labels turn reconnaissance into a briefing: missile trailers, launching equipment and tent areas are the identifications of U.S. intelligence analysts at this site.
interpretation.zh: 箭头与标注把侦察照片转化为简报：导弹拖车、发射设备与帐篷区域，是美国情报分析人员对这处基地的辨识。

note.en: The item is Photograph PX1966-020-007, Briefing Board 07, in the Department of Defense Cuban Missile Crisis Briefing Materials, Collection JFK-5047. Federal military creation is identified by NARA, rather than merely inferred from archival custody; no outside photographer is credited.
note.zh: 照片编号PX1966-020-007，简报板第07号，出自国防部古巴导弹危机简报资料（JFK-5047收藏）。国家档案馆明确标识其联邦军事机关制作背景，未列私人摄影者。
